mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conversation c JOIN conversation_message m ON m.conversation_id=c.id LEFT JOIN conversation_job_retry r ON r.message_id=m.id WHERE c.parent_user_id=#{parent} AND c.student_id=#{student} AND (m.status='RUNNING' OR r.status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')))
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET parent_user_id=#{recipient},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE parent_user_id=#{parent} AND student_id=#{student}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM conversation WHERE parent_user_id=#{parent} ORDER BY student_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM message_evidence WHERE message_id IN (SELECT m.id FROM conversation_message m JOIN conversation c ON c.id=m.conversation_id WHERE c.parent_user_id=#{parent})
DELETE FROM conversation_message WHERE conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM conversation WHERE parent_user_id=#{parent})
